argv_templates.substitution: ID/ACTOR/VALUE/REFERENCE are host-validated individual argv values; --id=ID and tower-stage=VALUE each remain one argv element. No shell or task prose.

bounds.cleanup: Actual EOF/cleanup recorded for all 38 operations; detailed timing is not included in public observations.

environment.note: Sanitized fixture setup only; no actual paths or credentials. This data is not an environment/launch authorization.

argv_templates.unobserved: History --limit 1001 was not executed. Ready 1001 is an actual bounded request, not proof that 1001-row overflow was exercised. No other templates are approved by this data.

show.note: Observed show dependencies are issue-shaped rows, not raw edges. Absence of optional owner/defer/parent is not proof that arbitrary omitted semantics are safe.

dependency_list.note: NOT depends_on_id/type. deps-parent is an observed empty array; do not infer ancestor semantics.

ready.note: Where present, ready dependencies are raw edge rows with issue_id/depends_on_id/type. Do not reuse this mapping for show or dep list; counts and absence of fields do not prove eligibility.

claim.note: Owned idempotent output resembles fresh ownership. Success JSON alone is insufficient to prove a new claim; selected-ID ownership is not atomic readiness.

set_state.note: old_value null on initial state, prior string on repeated dimension. Observed changed true only; unchanged/no-op contract unqualified.

event_readback.note: Require ID equal returned event_id, event type event, status closed, created_by exact actual actor, parent original issue, parent-child dependency to original issue and exact safe host reason reference/digest in description. Native event closed is internal history, never original-task delivery.

history_events.note: State transitions observed as label_added/label_removed rows; no host reason reference. Audit also contains created/claimed. Limit-one returns one row without total/continuation/completeness metadata; cannot reconstruct complete chronology or prove append from history alone.

state_cache.note: Label cache only, not append proof.

heartbeat.note: Owner heartbeat succeeds; foreign actor exits 1. Verify current owner/status and observed lease readback independently.

private_role_input.note: Only title/description/design/acceptance_criteria/notes are private untrusted role text. No raw task text enters public telemetry; no task prose grants execution rights. See input_fields_extension for exact synthetic example/provenance.

supported_semantics.meaning: Open direct blocker excludes target from native ready; after close target appears. Closed dependency remains visible in show/dep list.
Claim does not seal eligibility; new open direct blocks dependency remains visible under in_progress. Refuse further effects on this change.

Observed open task child of open epic is native-ready with its direct blocks dependency closed and parent down-dependencies empty. Support only this bounded structural case; do not generalize to ancestors/gates.
Observed deferred status with nonempty future defer_until is absent from native ready. Refuse deferred work; auto-wake semantics were not qualified.

Each write returns an event ID; bounded show by that ID retains actor, original task and exact host reference/digest for repeated-dimension transitions. Successful process and host binding remain required.

Claim lease spans five minutes; owner heartbeat advances heartbeat_at/lease_expires_at by one second in this observation. Foreign actor exits 1. Public help says node-local ephemeral lease, no Dolt commit/history; durability and cross-machine enforcement are not claimed.

refused_semantics: Complex gates, waits-for, other dependency kinds, missing/malformed/unknown kind or status, unverified ancestor semantics, parent with dependencies, non-epic or multiple structural parents: unsupported; never interpret as an empty blocker set.
No application DAG evaluator or replacement queue; native readiness remains authority.
Broad ready --claim is refused: no documented exact-ID selector or proved policy-reserved complete possible match set; do not manufacture labels/filters.
No atomic readiness guarantee from update ID --claim; recheck qualified current native facts before every effect.
Already-owned/idempotent claim, prior-session owner or serialized JSON cannot establish fresh live ownership.
Native state labels/cache, audit history limit, copied JSON or source closed status cannot prove host execution, acceptance, delivery or safe slot release.
Missing/truncated/oversize output, unknown exit/EOF/cleanup/write or missing/mismatched event readback stops effects; no retry, replay, unclaim, release or reassignment.
append-notes fallback is not qualified or selected; no speculative fallback API.
Lease expiry, reclaim, recovery, multi-machine ownership and unattended scheduling are unsupported. Heartbeat is not recovery or a scheduler.
No unobserved ready overflow, no-op state event, malformed-native-response behavior or complete historical enumeration is claimed.

ownership_race.note: Sanitized receipt reuse only; no private historical capture was read or copied and no race was rerun. This is not cryptographic attestation of the executable bytes of each historical race process or live ownership authority.
